sloka: स्वयंवरे किल प्राप्ता त्वमनेन यशस्विना ।राघवेणेति मे सीते कथा श्रुतिमुपागता ॥ २.११८.२४॥
transliteration: svayaṁvare kila prāptā tvamanena yaśasvinā ।rāghaveṇeti me sīte kathā śrutimupāgatā ॥ 2.118.24॥

translations.english: O Sita, I have heard that you have been won by the illustrious Rama in the swayamvara. At least that is the story which reached my ears.
